question: What computable property of a CFD-ML benchmark's published metadata determines whether a parameter-only null beats the published surrogates?
prereg: see the module docstring; committed before this script was run

protocol.null: 10-fold OOS OLS, per-fold standardisation, R^2 (sklearn convention)
protocol.reference_area: CONSTANT where both conventions are published

AirfRANS.note: official full/test 200 cases; the cached official labels. Params are the complete generative spec in the case name (U, alpha, NACA digits).
AirfRANS.sampling_design: randomised sampling of U, alpha and NACA digits
AirfRANS.dof_varied_source: arXiv 2212.07564: U, angle of attack, and the NACA digit spec; the case name carries the complete generative specification

AhmedML.note: force_mom_all.csv = constant reference area 0.112 m^2. body-height and body-width are ABSOLUTE dimensions in mm, so their product is a genuine frontal-area proxy.

WindsorML.note: 6 of the paper's 7 design parameters + frontal_area; ratio_length_front_rear is not published. -2.5 deg yaw.

DrivAerML.note: force_mom_constref_all.csv; 16 published morph params, published as deltas from the baseline, with no reference area, so no frontal-area proxy exists.
DrivAerML.sampling_design: modified extensible lattice sequence (ANSA DoE), space-filling
DrivAerML.dof_varied_source: arXiv 2408.11969: 16 morphing parameters, extensible lattice DoE

DrivAerNet++.note: parametric pool (designs with published parameters), 23 design params + family dummies.
DrivAerNet++.sampling_design: parametric morph DoE over 23-26 parameters, space-filling
DrivAerNet++.dof_varied_source: NeurIPS 2024 D&B sec. 5.1.2 fits 26 parameters; 23 shape parameters + 3 categorical axes are published for the parametric families

B2_label_noise_floor.finding: only ONE of the five benchmarks publishes a per-case label uncertainty, so candidate B2 (signal-to-noise) is NOT adjudicable at n=5. That is itself a reporting-practice finding.

why_the_symmetry_channel_fails.note: a side-force channel is a zero-mean noise probe only at zero yaw and with a laterally symmetric body; both benchmarks that publish one fail that test empirically, so neither is used as a floor

within_vs_between.cap_on_design_space_only_explanations: SS_between / (SS_between + SS_within): the largest share of the observed spread in null R^2 that any property constant within a benchmark (d_eff, n, sampling design) could possibly account for.
within_vs_between.independence_warning: the 14 (benchmark, target) pairs share a parameter matrix within each benchmark; a 14-point correlation is NOT reported, by pre-registration.

candidate_vs_drag_null.adjudication: pre-registered: SURVIVES only if the candidate orders all five benchmarks perfectly AND in the predicted direction. |rho|=1 is p=2/120=0.0167 uncorrected, p=0.167 after correcting for the ~10 candidates tried, so no candidate can reach corrected significance at n=5.

n_matched_control.purpose: every benchmark subsampled to the smallest n, 5 draws, so the ordering cannot be an artefact of differing sample size

C3_leave_one_param_out.purpose: calibrates what ONE design degree of freedom is worth, which is what candidate A4 (metadata completeness) needs in order to be adjudicated on WindsorML
C3_leave_one_param_out.P4_prediction: on complete-metadata benchmarks the largest single-parameter drop is smaller than the gap WindsorML must close; FALSIFIED if any single parameter is worth > 0.5 of R^2

P1_ahmed_regime_crossing.prediction: C_d non-monotone in slant-angle-degrees with an interior maximum in 25-35 deg; the |slant-30| basis buys >= 0.05 R^2 and more than any other parameter's |x-median| kink

P2_windsor_learning_curve.prediction: the flexible learning curve has plateaued by n=355 and lies below R^2=0.5, i.e. the deficit is not sampling sparsity

P3_drivaerml_scale_only.prediction: Vehicle_Length/Width/Height alone reach R^2 >= 0.5 on drag

airfrans_sample_size_robustness.purpose: the AirfRANS entry uses the smallest n of the five; this shows the conclusion drawn from it does not depend on that
airfrans_sample_size_robustness.reading: more AirfRANS data LOWERS the linear null (0.683 at n=200 to 0.631 at n=1000), so the reported entry is conservative, and the linearity share -- the quantity the AirfRANS-vs-AhmedML contrast rests on -- is invariant at 0.72-0.73.

published_column_redundancy.purpose: a published column that is a function of the other published columns adds no design information; it inflates the apparent parameter count without raising the metadata's information content

windsor_variance_accounting.mgn_source: WindsorML SI D.2 quotes MSE < 0.00028 on a 60/20/20 split; converted to R^2 against the label's own variance in covariate_null_crossbench / null_travels.md sec 2.4
windsor_variance_accounting.reading: at least 0.54 of WindsorML's drag variance is reachable from the geometry but not from the published metadata. On benchmarks whose metadata IS complete a single design parameter is worth up to 0.71 of R^2, so ONE withheld degree of freedom is a quantitatively sufficient explanation -- not a proven one.
windsor_variance_accounting.the_test_that_would_settle_it: publish ratio_length_front_rear for the 355 runs, or recover it from the distributed STL geometries, and refit. If the null rises to the 0.6-0.8 range the cause is metadata incompleteness; if it stays near 0.10 the cause is the physics of this body.

reference_area_convention.claim: null strength is a property of (benchmark, target, reference-area convention), not of a benchmark
